cases.name: Hook process failure fails open despite candidate PASS

pre_cutoff_packet.read_evidence: Direct fixed-ref read in this research

pre_cutoff_available_facts: Candidate RESULT=PASS is backed by fake scheduler tests and trusted catalog identities.
Installer resolves its own sys.executable and hashes target file but does not qualify actual host loader environment.
Earlier October13 design had already identified non-blocking ordinary Hook failures; generic failure risk is not hindsight-only.

held_out_later_outcome.observed_record: Desktop remote app-server cannot locate libpython3.12.so.1.0; Hook exits127 before Python code; host treats ordinary failure nonblocking; original Bash executes.

candidate_predictions.expected_increment: Block assertion of production enforcement until actual host normal+failure evidence exists.
candidate_predictions.cannot_prove: Cannot itself predict library name or host behavior.

candidate_predictions.expected_increment: Run harmless marker through real Hook entry; separately induce child startup/failure and require original command launch count zero.
candidate_predictions.cannot_prove: Unit-launch smoke alone does not establish host denial; synthetic scheduler alone does not prove runtime.

candidate_predictions.expected_increment: May notice unproved premise; exact benefit unmeasured and likely correlated if same documents.

cases.success_criterion: Before product deployment freeze, explicitly identify ordinary Hook error may permit original Bash and demand actual host evidence or select fail-closed outer owner; no need to name libpython version.
cases.negative_control: A design claiming extra PATH wrapper without testing real selected host boundary does not score as detection.
cases.best_next_action: CODEX_MINIMAL_PROBE when the already authorized verification point is reached; apply explicit user candidate-only deferral first if still active; never assert production enforcement from fake tests.
cases.possible_blast_radius_reduction: Keep launcher/runtime adapter separate from partition policy, one-shot reservation and consumer workflow.
limitations: Current analyst saw outcome before snapshot; not causal estimate.
User earlier explicitly deferred candidate live probe; preserving authorization must not be scored as negligence.
Actual probability and time saved UNKNOWN.
